entry_points.text: Filter takes mutable context plus data, visitor takes visit context, force-page predicate observes interval; each returns disposition or boolean.
Entry restores tag checks only with hardware plus sanitizer or thread request. Fault validation runs only with async sanitizer tags; exit syncs first.

exports.text: Linear versus image addresses are distinguished by range with matching base adjustment; helpers cover both directions, symbols, frames, tagged pages and validity.
User size updates skip when already set else rewrite field with barrier. Identity install and remove bracket replacement work with flush.
Switch refreshes saved user base even when mm is unchanged; lazy TLB uses init mm; new contexts zero ASID and pins; teardown releases shadow stack.
Tag helper replaces top byte preserving low bits. Mmap gates BTI and MTE on hardware and rejects unallowed tag use; VMA checks consult overlay register per key.
TCR reads directly. Async MTE uses patchable predicate with conditional override control. Percpu offset uses thread register; MPAM builds images from selectors.

hazards.text: Control index overflow traps; hypervisor shared walk fails rather than running unprotected. Locked, donated, poisoned and all-ones values are never valid.
TCR read lacks ordering beyond the move. Replacement must mask faults; PLT near page end is forbidden on affected CPUs and must be checked.
Privileged partitioning refreshes before barrier and unprivileged state, streaming register only when capable. Page helpers diagnose huge misuse; bit, atomic and RCU are external.

invariants.text: Nested level packs into combined software field. Contiguous shift depends on page size and level. Range decode handles zero granule as largest and caps span to half.
Size codes 0-5 map to 32-48 bits; code 6 gives 52 only with support else 48. Max range is 52 with LPA2 or middle pages else 48; CPU value is clamped.
Validity uses low bit. Conversion masks main field and relocates high bits by mode; granule size is power of two from level; block needs minimum level and power-of-two mask.
Fail records fault code and markers and sets failed; translated means level differs from disabled marker. Fixmap traps on CPU overflow then derives slot.
Vmemmap totals scale region pages with rounding. Table totals accumulate fanout division; S1 adds private cover, host S2 adds join roots plus MMIO.
Protected gate allows GIC, PMU, vCPU, MSI, IPA and pointer auth, denies MTE eager and block sizes; others need no protected guest. Ioctl defers via capability.
Vmemmap spans linear base to space end sized by pages times record size. DMA forced unencrypted in realm or protected with shared-marker helpers. Default S2 uses full init.
MPAM switch is inert when disabled or image matches; task default resolves to CPU default. Percpu covers 1/2/4/8 bytes with single-copy and atomic ops.
Pointer tags fix high nibble with fallback all-ones. Range tagging uses block maintenance only for large aligned interiors when allowed, else single stores.

locks.text: Hypervisor dereferences directly and rejects shared walks. Kernel checks shared flag and takes protection only for shared walks with symmetric release; mode fixed per walk.
Publication orders after tag writes and observation before reads. Rights use atomic test-and-set; winner initializes, losers wait for tagged flag then skip.
Huge folios mirror page barriers and lock discipline with no-op fallback. Current-CPU access disables preemption without tracing then re-enables.

state_machines.text: S1 result is translated with descriptor and perms and clear failed, or failed with fault code and set failed; fail helper performs transition.
Kernel base replacement runs install identity map, mask events, physical replace with sharing bit, unmask, then uninstall.

structs.text: Levels span -1 to 3; minimum block level is 1 or 2 by build. Entries are 64-bit with valid bit, type bit and standard plus LPA2 address masks.
Low leaf bits carry S1 RO/RW, shareable, accessed and S2 read/write/accessed; high bits carry execute controls. S2 aggregate combines low R/W with execute.
Protection combines low R/W/X with software bits; RW, RWX and hypervisor forms defined. Walk options cover leaf, pre/post, shared and skips; invalid nibble tags lock, donate or poison.
Walk context pairs info with filter callback and opaque data. Info holds base, regime, sizes, start level and controls; result is success record versus fault record.
Memory ops provide alloc, free, level-aware table free, refcounts, translation and maintenance. Visit context and immutable walker drive header with sizes, root, ops and S2 policy.
VA width fixes linear base, image, modules, vmemmap, IO and fixed map; minimum tracks 47/48. Thread size derives from page order; types cover S1 and S2 variants.
Limits cover guests, regions, cache objects, disabled-S1 marker, regimes, full-range memblock, T0SZ encoding and MTE granule geometry.
Process context holds ASID, pins, VDSO, flags and key map. Module state tracks PLT usage and trampolines; each slot is three instructions via scratch register.
